title: Machine learning accelerated high-throughput screening of zeolites for the selective adsorption of xylene isomers
summary: Eight hypothetical topologies were predicted to exceed the established selectivity benchmark in computational screening. The claim is a computational prediction; candidates were not synthesized or tested experimentally.
ai_technology: Neural screening prioritizes zeolite topologies, followed by classical adsorption simulations for xylene-isomer selectivity.
